decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	The installation of rooflights to the front and rear of the house and new windows to the side elevation, and ground floor rear elevation is considered to be satisfactory, as, due to the proportions, design and scale of the windows, it achieves the aims of retaining the original appearance the house, which preserves and enhances the character and appearance of Old Chiswick Conservation Area. Therefore the proposed development complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 New Development, ENV-B.2.2 Conservation Areas, and the Supplementary Planning Guidance.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
description: Installation of 2 rooflights in the front roof slope,  2 rooflights in the rear roof slope, conversion of roof area, two new windows at second floor side elevation and replacement of rear door with french doors to the existing house
